data.description: In Lund, Sweden, on September 15, 2026, InCoax Networks AB (publ) is enhancing its market presence in Finland amid the swift growth of fiber networks to various regional areas. Fibernet Finland, a Finnish fiber operator, has confirmed a recent purchase order for the company, reflecting the escalating demand for high-speed internet connectivity among residents in smaller cities, towns, and governmental divisions.

data.title: Borr Drilling Limited - Streamlines Mexico Operations
data.description: In a recent statement from Hamilton, Bermuda on September 15, 2026, Borr Drilling Limited (NYSE: BORR) (OSE: BORR) revealed plans to sell its 51% ownership stake in Mexican joint ventures alongside Perforaciones Estratégicas. This move marks a significant development for Borr Drilling, signaling a strategic shift in its business operations.

data.title: CKGSB-IE University Report Reveals New Models of Chinese Companies Going Global
data.description: On September 15, 2026, the Cheung Kong Graduate School of Business (CKGSB) introduced the Chinese Companies' New Playbook for Going Global. Collaborating with IE University's China Observatory, the report explores how Chinese businesses are reassessing their approaches to global expansion.

data.title: HawkEye 360 Establishes First European Subsidiary in Luxembourg
data.description: HawkEye 360, Inc. (NYSE: HAWK), a leading company, has established its inaugural European subsidiary, HawkEye 360 Luxembourg, S.à r.l., on September 15, 2026. This move signifies a strengthened dedication to European clientele, allies, and industry affiliates. The creation of this EU entity underlines HawkEye 360’s enduring efforts to enhance relationships in the region and expand its presence.

data.title: SCIENCE IN SPORT NAMED OFFICIAL PERFORMANCE FUEL AND HYDRATION PARTNER FOR NIKE AFTER DARK TOUR
data.description: In Tokyo on September 15, 2026, a statement was released by the US announcing that Science in Sport has been selected as the Official Performance Fuel & Hydration Partner for the Nike After Dark Tour. This tour consists of seven night-running events in various cities worldwide. This partnership aims to provide support and assistance to runners during these iconic experiences. The Nike After Dark Tour, in collaboration with Science in Sport, will offer runners access to top-quality performance fuel and hydration products to enhance their running experiences.

data.title: Airports Council International World Calls for Modernisation of Outdated Airport Slot System Stifling Competition and Costing Passengers
data.description: The global airports trade association is advocating for a revamped, open, and cooperative strategy to maximize the efficient use of limited airport capacity, maintain competitiveness in market access, and ensure slot allocation matches the growing passenger demand. This call was made in Montreal on September 15, emphasizing the need for modernization in airport operations.

data.title: Scottish Rite for Children Honored Again as No. 1 in the Nation for Pediatric Orthopedic Care by U.S. News & World Report
data.description: For the second year in a row, Scottish Rite for Children has achieved the top spot in pediatric care according to U.S. News & World Report. The institution's dedication to patient well-being and restoring children's quality of life is evident in this achievement. The ranking, announced on September 15, 2026, solidifies Scottish Rite for Children's position as the best in the nation for pediatric healthcare.

This development, launching in Stockholm on September 15, 2026, comes in response to the increasing number of sustainability and due diligence regulations. For major global brands, the challenge lies in bridging the expanding disparity caused by these regulations.
